BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning tribal timber harvest excise tax agreements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tribal timber harvest excise tax agreements; and amending RCW 43.06.480.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 43.06.480 and 2007 c 69 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Timber harvest excise tax agreements—Quinault Nation.
BillSection.P: (1) The governor is authorized to enter into a timber harvest excise tax agreement with the Quinault Nation and the Confederated Tribes of the Colville Reservation. Agreements adopted under this section must provide that the tribal timber harvest excise tax rate be one hundred percent of the state timber harvest excise tax.
(2) A timber harvest excise tax agreement under this section is subject to RCW 43.06.475.

AnnNote.NoteP: Findings—Intent—2007 c 69: See note following RCW 43.06.475.
